source_text: Dominus pluit sulphur et ignem. Recordatus Abraham liberat Lot. Haec Homiliae IV finis de visitatione et iudicio. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Lord rained sulfur and fire. Having-remembered Abraham he-frees Lot. These of-Homily IV end about visitation and judgment. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[The Lord rained sulfur and fire >> Bible:Genesis 19:24]]. Having remembered Abraham, he frees Lot. This is Homily IV’s end on visitation and judgment. Amen.
